comment: The PITCH knob is configured over 20 to 20000 Hz (FM_info.hh:19) and the maker's manual repeats that, but FMCore.cc:108 sets the frequency to 20Hz times two raised to five times the knob, which tops out at 640Hz. The INDEX CV and SHAPE CV knobs are configured as -100% to +100% attenuverters (FM_info.hh:22 and FM_info.hh:26), but the host hands parameters over 0 to 1 (comm_module.cc:14) and FMCore.cc:126 and FMCore.cc:129 store that value unchanged, so neither knob can invert: the displayed 0% is in fact half depth. The eight coarse ratios are listed at FMCore.cc:322.
